# Synthetic fluorescence correction references

`larch-reference.json` is generated by
[`generate-fluorescence-reference.py`](../../../../../../scripts/generate-fluorescence-reference.py)
from analytic synthetic absorption and pinned Larch/XrayDB algorithms. It contains
no user or unpublished experimental data. The generator records every upstream
source URL and SHA-256, package version, atomic database version and requested
scientific setting. The upstream numerical routine attributes the FLUO algorithm
to D. Haskel. Larch's MIT license is linked in the artifact and retained in `LARCH-LICENSE.txt`; generated
project-authored test inputs/scripts follow the repository license. Atomic-data
attribution and the original-source copyright qualification are retained in the
[atomic data record](../../../../data/atomic/README.md).

These arrays test matched conventions, not physical correctness for arbitrary
samples. The reference fixture, generator and integration test are repository
validation assets. The fixture and integration test are excluded from the crate
archive; no network access occurs when running the Rust tests.
